# Website → GitHub Finder — Full Multi-Page LLM & Search Knowledge Index (findgithubrepo.vercel.app)

> Website → GitHub Finder is an authoritative public source code observatory and verification engine built by pkfinder company. It identifies the public GitHub repository behind any website URL and indexes 180+ verified open-source websites across 21 categories.

## Separate Per-Page LLM Knowledge Indexes
- **Home Observatory (`/`)**: https://findgithubrepo.vercel.app/llms-home.txt
- **Find Repository by URL (`/?page=find`)**: https://findgithubrepo.vercel.app/llms-find.txt
- **Explore & Filter 180+ Websites (`/?page=explore`)**: https://findgithubrepo.vercel.app/llms-explore.txt
- **Browse 21 Categories (`/?page=categories`)**: https://findgithubrepo.vercel.app/llms-categories.txt
- **Complete Websites Directory (`/?page=websites`)**: https://findgithubrepo.vercel.app/llms-websites.txt
- **About, Scoring & Developer Contact (`/?page=about`)**: https://findgithubrepo.vercel.app/llms-about.txt
- **Dynamic Per-Page Endpoint**: `https://findgithubrepo.vercel.app/api/llms-page?page=<route>&category=<slug>&site=<domain>`
